quests.title: Priorities First

dialogue.t: Huh? We can get in through here? Paimon thought a place full of secrets would be more heavily guarded than this!
Whoa! This is way down under the ground!
Tch... Paimon knew it'd be sealed shut!
Now Paimon's even more curious... What kind of facility is this? If only we could get inside and take a look...
Traps!? But how come there's no alarm going off?
Don't tell Paimon the staff have to figure their way through all this, too? That's downright cruel...
We have to go even deeper? How does anyone put up with working in a place with no sunlight?
Hmm, maybe that's the point. If they never see the sun, they won't know when it's time to clock out! How horrible!
Alright, that's all three sets of data! Let's head back to the underground lab!
{NICKNAME}, let's input the data!
What's this? It looks like something to record data with...
Hmm... looks like this door won't open. Paimon's really curious about what's on the other side...

dialogue.sit: There must be an evil experiment going on inside...

dialogue.t: Considering where it is, this doesn't seem like the kind of place where anything important would be...
Now we've really gotta take a look inside! Otherwise, it'll sit in Paimon's head like having a belly full of Nod-Krai Hot Dogs that just won't go down!
The door might be locked, but maybe there's another way in.
So many jars! And inside them... could it be kuuvahki?
What are the Fatui doing, placing these things so deep underground?

dialogue.sit: So they can use them, of course...
It must be some kind of evil experiment!

dialogue.t: Obviously, Paimon knows that! But what are they using them for? Presumably, it's not for bathing...
{NICKNAME}, let's investigate around here first. Maybe we'll uncover some clues.
（test）阅读物占位-通告
This isn't what we're looking for...
（test）阅读物占位-研究记录-差图片
Looks like some sort of research records?
(I wonder what's inside...)
(test) Readable Placeholder - Research Log
Hmm... This doesn't seem very useful.
It looks like they really were doing experiments here, but this isn't the only place. There are three more sites up on the surface.
They're collecting data from those sites and then sending it down here for analysis. Hey, {NICKNAME}, what if we made off with all their data?
Oh, actually, Paimon's kinda curious about what they found out. How about... how about we collect the data from all three sites, check the results, and then take everything with us!?

dialogue.sit: Why do we need to take the results?
Feels like it'd be simpler to just destroy everything...

dialogue.t: Duh! So the Fatui don't get their hands on them!
Besides, aren't you the least bit curious about the results, {NICKNAME}? Come on, let's give it a try!
It looks like they really were doing experiments here, but this isn't the only place. There are three more sites up on the surface.
Huh? Wait a minute, was that stuff we picked up earlier the data the Fatui were trying to retrieve?
How about... how about we input all the data, check the results, and then take everything with us?

dialogue.sit: Why do we need to take the results?
Feels like it'd be simpler to just destroy everything...

dialogue.t: Duh! So the Fatui don't get their hands on them!
Besides, aren't you the least bit curious about the results, {NICKNAME}? Come on, let's give it a try!
We're locked in! This has to be another trap. How are we supposed to get out...?
The device has been activated? Does that mean...
Let's see which filthy rat has snuck in this time... You!? You're the criminals who ruined the experiment site! And now you dare come here!?
{NICKNAME}, Paimon doesn't feel like a beating right now! Quick, do something about that barrier!
We finally got rid of them — huh? Why isn't the machine showing anything? Don't tell me it got broken during the fight... Or did the Fatui shut it down?
Ugh, all that and we still didn't get to see the results...
...{NICKNAME}, did you hear that strange sound just now? P—Paimon thinks it came from that way...
...Wow! Is that a white Weasel Thief? Paimon's never seen one that white before!
P—Paimon's Mora! Stop right there, you thief!

dialogue.sit: Unable to catch up, you watch helplessly as the white Weasel Thief runs away...

dialogue.t: Ugh, it zipped away just like that...

dialogue.sit: Good thing I didn't lose anything.

dialogue.t: But Paimon did! Paimon's secret stash. Waaah... If Paimon ever runs into that Weasel Thief again, Paimon's gonna make it pay back double!

quests.description: The Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau clearly has many more secrets…
